%doc: Source-of-truth manifest of the SMW properties Module:Company emits via getStructuredData -> mw.smw.set. Multi-value fields are SEMICOLON-separated. Page-type properties (Founder, Parent company, Subsidiaries, Predecessor, Successor) store the wikilink TARGET(s). Headquarters stores one star system per HQ: the last wikilink of each semicolon-separated HQ segment (convention 'place, ..., system'). Industry/Products store the per-item delink + lcfirst display label, semicolon-split. Founded is the clean year (the module renders the date via {{Start date and age}} for display only). Display-only fields (Area served, Key people, Fate, Defunct, Formerly, Allies, Rivals) are intentionally absent. Plain SMW, not Buckets.
